held_items.title: Price and hero pack size
held_items.reason: The storefront price varies by pack size and the brief gives no approved commercial value.
held_items.required_evidence: Brand-approved hero pack size and advertising price with a named approver.

held_items.title: Brand pack and logo advertising rights
held_items.reason: Public product images and logo are not an advertising licence.
held_items.required_evidence: Written paid-media approval and high-resolution pack and logo masters.

held_items.title: Voice and music licences
held_items.reason: No voice performer release or music licence has been supplied.
held_items.required_evidence: Signed performer release and a production-library licence covering paid YouTube.

held_items.title: Demonstration and talent release
held_items.reason: Hands and a demonstration set appear on camera; no release is supplied.
held_items.required_evidence: Signed hand-model/performer release and approval to film the product demonstration.

held_items.title: Brand typeface
held_items.reason: No Blue Tokai brand font was supplied; Inter is a placeholder.
held_items.required_evidence: Brand font files and typography guidance, or written approval to use Inter for this production.
